anya: Heads-up: night window kernel/quant swap scheduled at 01:00 UTC. We're testing engine-v3.12-minikernel + qv2-int8. Requesting quick pin + 0.5% canary to start.
lena: Can we keep pin TTL short (1h) and exclude low-memory hosts?
anya: yes. deploybot command below.
anya: ```
curl -XPOST https://deploybot/release -d '{"bundle":"engine-v3.12-minikernel","pin":"true","ttl":3600,"canary":0.005}'
```
deploybot: Release request received. Scheduling canary at 2025-09-20T01:00:00Z. Pin TTL 3600s. Tracking: https://deploy/redwood/rel/1768881234
marc: QA ran quick passes on qv2-int8: perf ok but saw elevated mem on small batch. sharing reproducer.
omar: repro confirms increase when batch=1 and kvcache disabled. Diff log: small truncation in long prompts + occasional mem spike.
ops-bot: Monitoring rule 'canary-int8-memory' firing on 3 hosts.
lena: pause ramp. we'll pin back if OOMs reproduce. anya, please hold.
anya: pausing. I'll start emergency pin-back plan if needed.
deploybot: Canary paused. Options: (1) pin-back to engine-v3.11-stable, (2) gate int8 artifact to qv2-rr, (3) enable mem-safety flag.
nina - release: drafting note for internal channels. Proposed rollback criteria: OOM or token-diff >2% or sustained P95 +10% for 10m.
marc: recommend pin-back. I'll file a patch to revert allocator tweak and add CI mem-case.
olena: (typo)
lena: rolling rollback to v3.11 now. `curl -XPOST https://deploybot/release -d '{"bundle":"engine-v3.11-stable","pin":"true","ttl":10800}'`
deploybot: Rollback pin created by lena. Canary slice set to 0%. Drains initiated for affected hosts.
omar: post-rollback smoke clean. no OOMs in 15m. P95 within baseline.
nina - release: internal note: "Emergency rollback: engine-v3.12-minikernel int8 path caused memory regressions on small-batch workloads; rolled back to v3.11-stable. No customer impact. Follow-ups: revert allocator tweak, add batch=1 mem tests, re-run canary behind feature flag."
anya: thanks team. I'll own the follow-up tickets and schedule a reattempt behind feature flag. ping @channel if anything else pops up.
